crashCapture.finding: Crashpad writes a dump for a renderer crash (Page.crash) and for a browser crash (Browser.crash), into the profile's Crashpad\\reports, with or without --enable-crash-reporter-for-testing. Chromium's docs/win_cross.md says a cross build cannot report crashes; in this tree the assembly files are assembled (llvm-ml). Nothing is uploaded: the build has no crash server.

notes: Chromium's installer registers the preview for more URL schemes than Electron Blanc does (mailto, tel, irc and others, as Chrome does). These are capabilities in Default Programs, not defaults.
